purpose: Turn demonstrated AI/project-operation failures into repeatable capability/regression evals without pretending deterministic CI can judge open semantics.

judgement: material appropriateness where several actions are valid
grading.rule: Deterministic PASS is not proof of domain truth, complete impact discovery or owner acceptance.

promotion.capability_case: New demonstrated failures may begin as capability evals.
promotion.regression_case: After a control/fix is accepted, retain the historical failure as a regression.
